objective: Show that in an unsatisfiable native network every knot whose removal keeps the network connected allows exactly half the states of its edges, so that every native contradiction, cut at its bridges with the forced values pinned, is an unsatisfiable system of parity equations; derive a polynomial-time decision procedure for native networks of every law, removing the dependence of ticket A's tractability on Kazda, Kolmogorov and Rolinek.
status: Proved by NATIVE-HARDNESS-20261024-001C-P001 (V1 prose proof with standard-library check; no external theorem). Half rule: in an unsatisfiable native network every knot whose removal keeps it connected has a parity face and the rest allows the complementary relation, since each allows at least half of the knot's edge states. So every native contradiction, cut at its bridges, is a set of unsatisfiable parity systems, and native networks of every law are decided in polynomial time, making ticket A's tractability unconditional.
title: Native contradictions are linear
